task:
BUILD THE PURE RAVEN-LAYOUT IMPORT MODULE FOR THE V3 COLONY PLANNER (SLICE S4b, PART 1: PARSER ONLY, NO UI). apps/web ONLY, TWO NEW FILES PLUS A FIXTURE. NO NETWORK, NO NEW DEPENDENCIES.

Authority: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-v3-colony-planner-design.md section 4.1 and section 7 (S4b row: "Raven layout import from a file the commander exports: sites, statuses and recorded slot counts"). Raven Colonial is GPL-3 software: do NOT copy, port or look up any Raven code. This module only reads the JSON layout file a commander downloads from Raven, which is the commander's own data; the identifier mapping below is an interoperability table, not Raven code.

Files (nothing else; do not edit any index/barrel file, the plan page, stores or the API client — the /plan page is being built in a separate slice and will wire this in later):
- apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/raven-import.ts
- apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/raven-import.test.ts (vitest, following apps/web test conventions)
- apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/__fixtures__/raven-layout-sample.json — a SYNTHETIC layout you write yourself in the shape below, with invented system/body/site names and no commander names.

INPUT SHAPE (a Raven layout file, version "6"; values may be strings or numbers where noted; ignore unknown extra fields):
{
  "v": "6",                       // string or number; only 6 is accepted
  "name": "<system name>",
  "id64": "<digits>",             // string or number
  "bodies": [ { "name": "<full body name>", "num": 0, "parents": [..], "type": "st", "subType": "...", "features": [...] }, ... ],
  "sites":  [ { "id": "x123", "name": "<site name>", "bodyNum": 16, "buildType": "vulcan", "status": "complete" }, ... ],
  "slots":  { "<bodyNum>": [<orbital>, <surface>], ... }   // -1 means unknown / not applicable
}

OUTPUT (export these types and a `parseRavenLayout(input: unknown): RavenImportResult` function; never throw for bad content, return `ok: false` with errors):
type RavenImportResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  errors: { code: string; detail: string }[];            // fatal: wrong version, not an object, missing id64, limits exceeded
  system: { id64: string; name: string } | null;
  sites: { raven_site_id: string; raven_build_type: string; name: string; facility_id: string;
           slot_kind: 'orbital' | 'surface'; status: 'planned' | 'building' | 'complete' | 'demolished';
           raven_body_name: string | null }[];             // in Raven's site order
  slots: { raven_body_name: string; orbital_slots: number | null; surface_slots: number | null }[];
  warnings: { code: string; detail: string }[];          // non-fatal, one per skipped or partial item
};
Also export `matchRavenBodies(result, bodies: { body_id: string; name: string }[])` returning `{ siteBodyRefs: (string | null)[]; slotBodyRefs: (string | null)[]; warnings: {code; detail}[] }`, matching `raven_body_name` to an ED-Finder body by exact name, case-insensitive, after trimming; unmatched names give `null` and a warning naming the body.

RULES
- Status mapping: plan→planned, build→building, complete→complete, demolish→demolished. Any other status: skip the site with warning `unknown_status`.
- buildType → (facility_id, slot_kind), exactly this table (ED-Finder catalogue ids):
  aerecura→surface_settlement_extraction_t2_l (surface); aletheia→orbital_installation_comm_station (orbital); atropos→surface_planetary_port_outpost_civilian (surface); bacchus→orbital_installation_space_bar (orbital); ceres→surface_settlement_agriculture_t2_l (surface); chronos→surface_settlement_research_bio_t2_l (surface); dec_truss→dodecahedron_t3 (orbital); demeter→orbital_installation_space_farm (orbital); euthenia→orbital_installation_mining_outpost (orbital); fufluns→surface_settlement_tourism_t2_l (surface); hephaestus→surface_planetary_port_outpost_industrial (surface); hermes→orbital_installation_satellite (orbital); minerva→surface_settlement_military_t2_l (surface); molae→industrial_facility (surface); nemesis→orbital_outpost_military (orbital); ocellus→ocellus_station (orbital); opis→surface_planetary_port_outpost_industrial (surface); pistis→orbital_installation_comm_station (orbital); plutus→orbital_outpost_commercial (orbital); prometheus→orbital_outpost_scientific (orbital); quad_truss→coriolis_station (orbital); silenus→refinery (surface); vulcan→orbital_outpost_industrial (orbital).
  Any other buildType: skip the site with warning `unknown_build_type` naming the buildType and the site name (never drop silently).
  Add a test that every facility_id in the table exists in the ED-Finder facility catalogue (apps/api/src/domain/facility_catalogue_v1.json, the file apps/api/src/cpe/catalogue.py loads through domain/facilities.py; read it from the test via a relative path or a Vite JSON import — whichever the apps/web test setup supports; if neither works, hard-code the expected id list in the test and say so in the summary).
- Body: `bodyNum` → the Raven body with that `num` → its `name`; a missing body gives `raven_body_name: null` and warning `unknown_body`.
- Slots: for each `slots` entry whose key matches a Raven body `num`, emit `{raven_body_name, orbital_slots, surface_slots}` with -1 (or any negative, non-integer, or >64 value) → null; entries for unknown bodies → warning `unknown_slot_body`.
- Names: trim, cap at 64 characters (warn `name_truncated`).
- Limits (fatal errors): input must be a plain object; `v` must be 6; `id64` must be 1–19 digits; at most 1000 bodies and 300 sites (the evaluate API's limit); strings longer than 256 characters are rejected as `invalid_string`.
- Pure and deterministic: no Date, no randomness, no network, no DOM.

TESTS (vitest): the synthetic fixture parses with the expected counts; every status mapping; every buildType in the table maps (table-driven); unknown buildType and status are skipped with warnings; -1 and out-of-range slots become null; missing body; wrong version / wrong id64 / too many sites are fatal; name truncation; matchRavenBodies exact, case-insensitive and unmatched cases.

VALIDATION: in apps/web: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test` (report counts), `pnpm build`. SUMMARY: list the three files, paste the exported types, and confirm no other file changed and no Raven code was consulted.
